newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks calm in little trading.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks calm in little trading.

text.p: Stocks were calm amid little trading in the after-hours session, traders said Wednesday.

Madge Networks Inc was hovering at 15-3/8, near where it closed on the New York Stock Exchange at 15-1/8. The company reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.25 a share after charges. Before charges it reported a Q4 profit of $0.01 a share.
America Online did not trade in the session following news that it had agreed to give refunds to customers who had not been able to log on to its network.
"I haven't seen anything," the trader said.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 289,400 shares against Tuesday's 194,400 and session two had 1,726,400 shares against 14,957,030.
